posts.text: Field feedback on EURO7000 vs Fevicol Hi-per: has anyone seen similar? I recently spoke with a carpenter about EURO products and got some useful feedback. He said he had used EURO7000 white glue earlier but ran into a bubbling problem. He now prefers Fevicol Hi-per, which is marketed as having an anti-bubble formulation, and he sees EURO as a low-cost product that carries more risk. I’m aware that bubbling also depends on other factors: moisture (monsoon work, coastal areas), the carpenter’s skill, surface quality of the wood, and the coverage area.
